usedFor: TagMango holds creator courses and orders, and MSG91 opens a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello” for incomplete orders.

bestTemplate.name: “Incomplete Order Created” in TagMango, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: An unfinished order is a lost sale to chase, and the action opens a ticket or replies on one.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” replies on an existing ticket only with its ticket ID, otherwise it opens one.
